dslRule:
<!id: environment.variable.value.provider>
<!description: In ColumnLabelProvider, replace getName() with getValue() for EnvironmentVariable elements to display the correct property value.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.jface.viewers.ColumnLabelProvider.createTextProvider($param -> ((org.eclipse.debug.core.model.EnvironmentVariable) $param).getName())
=>
org.eclipse.jface.viewers.ColumnLabelProvider.createTextProvider($param -> ((org.eclipse.debug.core.model.EnvironmentVariable) $param).getValue())
;;
summary: Replace EnvironmentVariable.getName() with getValue() in ColumnLabelProvider for correct display.
